messages:
kari: Heads-up — PR #421 just flaked again in GHA where the eval-runner hits a timeout on the quantize job. Buildkite nightly succeeded. Can we converge on a PR-gate pattern so we don't block merges for heavy evals?

mike: Ugh seen this. GHA self-hosted runners OOM during the 8-bit quantize step. Error: `Killed` in logs. Nightly uses larger GPUs on BK so it's fine.

sophia: Quick data point: matrix of model variants + dataset shards pushes job time > 45m, and GHA default job timeout is 60m but we hit intermittent IO stalls, so flakiness.

jen: Options: 1) PR gate = smoke eval (small shard + one metric), 2) Full eval on nightly + upload artifacts to S3, 3) Reporter ingests artifacts and marks PR with a summary comment.

kari: I like that. Proposal: move heavy quantize + full evals to Buildkite nightly, keep PR GHA job as a fast smoke (accuracy sanity + latency sample + tokenization). If smoke fails, block. Otherwise, merge and nightly picks up full run.

mike: Agreed. Implementation notes: GH Actions workflow should run `scripts/eval_smoke.sh` which uses a cached quantized model artifact (pre-quantized for the PR base) so we only run a 1k-sample eval. Buildkite does `pipelines/eval-full.yml` with GPU matrix.

sophia: Also let's fix flaky runner by adding explicit pip wheel for `bitsandbytes` and pin CUDA drivers in BK images. GHA can't use our heavy GPU images easily.

kari: Here's a minimal GH Action snippet I tested that runs the smoke in ~4 minutes:

```
name: PR-eval-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup python
        run: python -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements-smoke.txt
      - name: Run smoke eval
        run: ./scripts/eval_smoke.sh --samples 1000 --model ${MODEL}
```

mike: For Buildkite, pipeline fragment to run full evals and upload results (S3 artifact):

```
steps:
  - label: "full-eval"
    agents: { "queue": "gpu-large" }
    command:
      - . ./venv/bin/activate
      - python -m pip install -r requirements-full.txt
      - python eval_full.py --config configs/full.yml --out results/${BUILDKITE_BUILD_NUMBER}
      - aws s3 cp results/${BUILDKITE_BUILD_NUMBER} s3://redwood-evals/${MODEL}/${BUILDKITE_BUILD_NUMBER} --recursive
```

jen: Good. Next piece: reporter service. We need a small lambda/ingest job that reads S3 artifact JSONs, computes summarized metrics (per-metric mean, delta vs baseline, flagged regressions), then posts a compact comment to GH PR with badges and a link to the dashboard.

sophia: Metric defs: we need canonical names in the artifact: "accuracy.top1", "perplexity.eval", "latency.p95", "mem.peak_mb". Reporter should use consistent thresholds from `eval_thresholds.yml`. Also include seed and shard info.

mike: Edge cases: if nightly hasn't finished yet for the PR base, reporter should mark as "pending nightly" and re-check on a 2h cadence. We should also attach the raw artifacts for debugging.

kari: CI permissions: GH app needs read access to S3 or we can have BK push artifact and trigger reporter via an SNS webhook. I'd prefer BK -> S3 + SNS -> reporter to avoid granting broad perms to GH. Thoughts?

jen: That sounds safer. BK IAM role uploads S3 and publishes SNS. Reporter (internal service) subscribes to SNS. Reporter uses short-lived STS creds to pull from S3. No GH secrets needed.

sophia: Small UX ask: PR comment should include a short table like: Model | smoke acc | smoke p95 | status (pass/warn). Use emojis for regressions (:warning:) and a link to full dashboard.

mike: Also add a PR action summary check by posting a GitHub check run with `conclusion: neutral` if smoke passed but nightly pending, and `conclusion: success` when nightly baseline within thresholds. `conclusion: failure` only for smoke fails or clear regression.

kari: Does anyone object to this rollout plan? I'll draft GH Actions + BK pipeline PR and the reporter Lambda prototype.

jen: No objections. Can you include a short README in `ci/evals/` describing the gating rules and how to reproduce locally?

kari: Yep. I'll open drafts: GH Actions -> #1799123460, Buildkite -> #1799123472, Reporter -> #1799123485.

gha-bot: Buildkite nightly pipeline triggered: eval-full (buildkite.com/redwood/inference) — started by schedule at 2026-10-12T00:05:00Z :rocket:

ci-bot: NOTE: Added issue #612 to umbrella for runner-image pinning and wheel caching.

mike: Follow-ups: (1) test reporter with a synthetic artifact, (2) add unit tests for threshold parsing, (3) add a small `eval_smoke` container to GH packages so we get deterministic deps.

sophia: I'll take the runner image work. jen will own the reporter proto. mike + kari pair on GH/BK wiring.

kari: Thanks all. Plan to roll out next week. I'll post PR links when ready. :thumbsup:
